What is a seamless carousel post?

A seamless carousel is a social media post (typically on Instagram or LinkedIn) consisting of multiple slides where the background or visual elements flow continuously from one slide to the next, creating a single panoramic experience when swiped.
How does Lovart ensure the images align perfectly?

Lovart utilizes an 'Infinite Canvas' approach. Instead of designing separate squares, you design on one continuous panoramic layout. The AI then assists in placing elements across the cuts, ensuring pixel-perfect alignment when uploaded.
Can I maintain consistent characters across the carousel slides?

Yes, utilizing our 'Flux Context' or 'Nano Banana' models, Lovart excels at character consistency. You can define a subject once and the AI will render them consistently across different poses and scenes throughout your carousel story.
Does Lovart help with the text and story planning?

Absolutely. As an AI Design Agent, Lovart doesn't just generate images; it can help structure your narrative arc, suggest hooks for the first slide, and draft accompanying text that fits the visual layout.
Can I edit specific elements after generating the carousel?

Yes, with our 'Edit Elements' and 'Touch Edit' features, you can select any specific part of the carousel—like a text block or a background object—and modify, move, or regenerate it without affecting the rest of the design.
